observations.body: Jesus prays for those who will believe through the disciples’ word, asks for unity that the world may believe, speaks of shared glory, desired presence, known name, and indwelling love.
observations.label: Prayer widens to future believers, unity, glory, and love

observations.body: The passage presents Believing through their word as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Believing through their word

observations.body: The passage places Unity, glory, presence, and indwelling love beside Believing through their word.
observations.label: Unity, glory, presence, and indwelling love

payload.posture: Read John 17:20–26 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus prays for those who will believe through the disciples’ word, asks for unity that the world may believe, speaks of shared glory, desired presence, known name, and indwelling love. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: Prayer widens to future believers, unity, glory, and love
